_comment: Master HaHa-productId -> USAT-sales-SKU-name mapping, shared across every machine's analysis. Keyed by productId (a global catalog ID -- the same can of Coke has the same productId everywhere), so a mapping solved once for any machine applies to all of them. Every salesName/salesNames value must exist verbatim in usat-transaction-log.xlsx's Product column -- verify before adding, a typo silently produces a zero-sales row instead of an error. Read/written by scripts/analyze_removal_candidates.py. displayName (optional) is the warehouse inventory sheet's name for the product line, shown in the dashboard; falls back to salesName, then HaHa's name.
